Require: multi-task demonstration dataset \(\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{demo}}\) 1: Train \(V_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{demo}}\) using Eq. 1 2: Train \(\pi_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{demo}}\) using Eq. 3 and \(V_{\mathrm{pre}}\) 3: Initialize \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) with demonstrations for \(\ell\) 4: Train \(V_{\ell}^{0}\) from \(V_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) using Eq. 1 5: Train \(\pi_{\ell}^{0}\) from \(\pi_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) using Eq. 3 and \(V_{\ell}^{0}\) 6: for \(k = 1\) to \(K\) do 7: Collect data with \(\pi_{\ell}^{k - 1}\), add it to \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) 8: Train \(V_{\ell}^{k}\) from \(V_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) using Eq. 1 9: Train \(\pi_{\ell}^{k}\) from \(\pi_{\mathrm{pre}}\) on \(\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\) using Eq. 3 and \(V_{\ell}^{k}\) 10: end for
